user.title: Connect to your panel
user.description: Enter the address of the RoboAlarms Panel on your network. You can find it on the panel under Settings > Integrations > Home Assistant.

confirm.title: RoboAlarms Panel found
confirm.description:
Do you want to add {name} ({host}) to Home Assistant?

You will confirm the pairing on the panel's screen.

pair.title: Pair with the panel
pair.description:
On the panel, open Settings > Integrations > Home Assistant and tap **Pair with Home Assistant** (it asks for the master or installer code). Pairing stays open for two minutes.

Then continue here.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the panel again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} no longer answers with the certificate it was paired with - usually after a factory reset. Open pairing on the panel (Settings > Integrations > Home Assistant > Pair), then continue here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the panel. Check that it is powered, on the same network, and that the Home Assistant integration is enabled on the panel (Settings > Integrations > Home Assistant).
error.unsupported: The panel speaks a different version of the link protocol. Update this integration and the panel's firmware to their latest versions.
error.not_pairing: The panel isn't pairing right now. Open pairing on its screen first, then try again.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already configured. Its address was updated.
abort.unknown: The discovered device did not identify itself as a RoboAlarms Panel.
abort.pair_timeout: Pairing timed out on the panel. Open it again and retry.
abort.pair_mismatch: The pairing could not be trusted and was stopped. Try again on a network you trust.
abort.wrong_device: That address now belongs to a different panel.
